name: Cube Foundry
detailed_description:
Dive into Cube Foundry, a captivating incremental game where every click counts! Starting from a single cube, expand your production to create an industrial empire. Unlock powerful generators, purchase strategic upgrades, and ascend through Mastery levels to dominate the cube universe. Simple to learn, incredibly satisfying to master!

🏗️ From Humble Clicks to Intergalactic Industry

Your journey begins with a single, mysterious Central Cube. Each click generates valuable resources — the first sparks of your future empire. But this is just the beginning.

Use your earnings to unlock a wide array of automated generators, each more advanced and efficient than the last. From the basic Mini Assembler to the awe-inspiring Dimensional Replicator, every machine helps you scale your cube production to astronomical levels.

⚙️ Optimize. Specialize. Evolve.

In the Upgrades Panel, build a production strategy that matches your style:

  • Increase your Click Power (CPC)

  • Amplify specific generators or overall CPS

  • Unlock special upgrades that merge active and passive income

Progression unfolds through branching upgrade trees — choose your focus: clicks, early economy, or advanced automation. Every upgrade has prerequisites, encouraging long-term planning and specialization.

🔁 Prestige & Purpose: Reset to Rise

Once your production reaches astronomical levels, it's time to reset — and evolve. Through the Prestige System, sacrifice short-term progress to gain Prestige Points (PP) and unlock permanent upgrades:

  • Boost CPC and CPS multipliers

  • Start future runs with pre-built advantages

  • Climb faster, stronger, and smarter with every loop

🧠 Master the Foundry

The deeper your cube journey, the more you unlock the Mastery System — a powerful metagame with two layers:

🎓 Mastery Levels grant permanent passive bonuses and Mastery Points (MP)
🔧 Mastery Attributes (Power, Efficiency, Economy, Prestige, Fortune) let you shape your factory’s strengths, with scaling costs that reward specialization and smart allocation.

🏆 Achievements & Secrets Await

Track your milestones — or stumble upon hidden ones. Whether it's your total clicks, mastery levels, or how many times you've prestiged, Achievements offer permanent rewards and secret bonuses for the most dedicated players.
